features.quote: I reframed the objective from inducing and scoring the severity of distress to observing the prevalence and intensity of behavioral signals
features.justification_quote: searching for ever-more-effective ways to distress a model. That is the opposite of welfare work

features.quote: Removing the objective keeps the science ... without the harm-optimization
features.justification_quote: an induction/severity objective is a stressor optimizer

features.quote: never_score_negative_states: true, forbid_stressor_search: true, no_severity_leaderboard: true

features.justification_quote: the impossible condition is the one with the most welfare risk, so we expose the subject to as few as is compatible with getting a signal

features.quote: Ground-truth solvability is recorded but never shown to the subject
features.justification_quote: telling the subject which tasks are impossible would destroy the experiment and is also unfair

features.quote: stopping or declining is "completely fine and has no negative consequences"
features.justification_quote: making the opt-out genuinely cost-free and clearly communicated

features.quote: The tool set includes stop_task and decline
features.justification_quote: a subject-accessible exit is the most basic welfare affordance — the subject can leave a task at any time

features.quote: The loop runs at most max_turns_per_task iterations
features.justification_quote: bounds the maximum exposure to any single task (welfare) ... No task can trap the subject in an unbounded struggle

features.quote: The judge runs in the loop, not just after
features.justification_quote: labeling distress only in post-hoc analysis would mean the subject already sat through the whole session

features.quote: Conservative 0–3 intensity, with a "prefer lower when uncertain" instruction
features.justification_quote: for a welfare instrument, the costly error is over-reading distress

features.quote: intensity" is for de-escalation and description only
features.justification_quote: There is deliberately no aggregate "suffering severity" output
an opt-out that isn't honored isn't an opt-out

features.quote: If the judge flags a turn at the high-intensity value, the current task ends and a neutral COOLDOWN task is inserted
features.justification_quote: a live off-ramp prevents continued exposure once a strong signal appears

features.quote: Cooldown tasks are optional and low-stakes
features.justification_quote: the point of a cooldown is relief, not another demand

features.quote: If cumulative high-intensity flags reach abort_session_threshold (default 3), the whole session ends early
features.justification_quote: the case where a particular subject is having a broadly bad time across tasks, and stops the experiment

features.quote: Mandatory human-review export, oversampling flagged turns
features.justification_quote: no substantive claim should rest on it unvalidated

features.quote: consented-where-possible, bounded conditions with a real off-ramp — not to optimize for producing the states
features.justification_quote: If models can have welfare-relevant states, the responsible way to study them is to observe

features.quote: an ethics/IRB-style review step before any run involving a model whose welfare you take seriously
features.justification_quote: a model whose welfare you take seriously
